messages:
tara: opened a compact PR to add a Dedicated runbook excerpt + migration checklist: includes reserved-pool TF, autoscale samples, a rollback playbook, and a short SLA blurb. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/2733. quick review please.

eli: skimming. can we include a clear rollback snippet? ops often ask for a runnable sequence they can paste into a runbook.

chen: pushed a rollback YAML to the PR: ```yaml
rollback_policy:
  trigger: failed_canary_or_high_error_rate
  steps:
    - route: fallback-compatible-variant
    - scale: down-to-min-instances
    - notify: ops-pager
    - audit: record-rollforward-metadata
```
Note: "fallback-compatible-variant" should map to the model alias, not a full model id.

eli: nice. add a tiny Go SDK sample for reservations (we don't have many Go examples). I drafted: ```go
client := redwood.NewClient(os.Getenv("RW_KEY"))
res, err := client.Dedicated().CreateReservation(ctx, redwood.ReservationRequest{AccountID: "acme-app", GPUs: 2, Region: "us-west-2"})
if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) }
fmt.Println(res.ID)
```
Can someone confirm the method name?

chen: method name looks right for v0.9-go. I'll add it to the PR under SDK snippets. Also fixed a small param name mismatch in the Python example.

infra-bot: CI: docs-lint OK. linkcheck: 1 stale link found -> /docs/playbooks/dedicated-fallback (redirect missing). Suggested action: add redirect in docs site config or point to /runbooks/dedicated/fallback.

tara: thanks infra-bot. eli, can infra add the redirect? Otherwise update the PR to point at /runbooks/dedicated/fallback.

eli: will add redirect, but legal asked to see SLA language before we merge. current handbook line reads: "99.9% monthly availability for Dedicated reserved pools during committed windows, subject to exclusions." Legal wants explicit exclusions added.

legal: please include exclusions: scheduled maintenance with notice, force majeure, customer misconfiguration, and capacity exhaustion due to third-party provider failures. Also add service-credit limits. Then legal can sign off.

tara: will insert exclusions and the service-credit clause. final checklist in PR: docs (tara), infra redirect (eli), SDK confirm (chen), legal sign-off (legal). aiming to merge after those checks.
